notes.title: V.31.0
notes.content:
[p]Three years ago, I made the decision to keep all games in the Barro franchise updated, including the older titles. This choice allowed the first game in the series to receive nearly 100 updates since its release — a milestone that makes the continuous addition of new content and improvements possible.[/p][p]With this new update, all games in the Barro series are now moving to the latest version. The fixes and changes made to the online multiplayer mode in [i]Barro GT[/i] are now also available in the other versions, ensuring consistency and improvements across the board.[/p][p]Optimizations have been made to game loading, which should result in faster startup times and reduced disk usage for some versions.[/p][p]Since this update brings significant changes, we kindly ask that any issues be reported on the community forum. This helps us identify and resolve any instability quickly.[/p][p]Lastly, we apologize for posting the same announcement across all games in the series. We understand it may seem repetitive, but it’s necessary for Steam to properly track updates for each title.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you for continuing to play. ːb22_upː[/p]

notes.title: [V.30.14] Improvements to online multiplayer.
notes.content:
Several improvements have been made to the online multiplayer mode, but most notably there is an improvement to the faster versions of the game (Barro F/F22/F25).

With this update, the driveability for the client should be much closer to that of the host, making the competition fairer.

If you see any bugs or something that shouldn't be happening, please use the game forums to report it. ːb22_upː


*This update is valid for versions of the game that already have online mode.
